name: selenyx
description: Selenyx 科研工作台 — 本地优先、BYOK、八段科研流水线（TypeScript + Python + Tauri 多语言架构）

scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && uv run uvicorn selenyx_backend.main:app --reload --port 8770
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.backend:bundle: cd backend && uv run --extra package python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onefile --name selenyx-backend --distpath dist --workpath build/pyinstaller --specpath build/pyinstaller sidecar.py && cd .. && node scripts/prepare-backend-sidecar.mjs
scripts.dev:local: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run backend:dev" "npm run dev"
